title: Decorate the tree
targetLabel: The tree: a mega tree, a matrix or any model with a grid
intro: Visitors decorate a tree of the show: each phone picks a free spot, a decoration (bauble, candy cane, star, bell, present, snowflake, heart) and one of 8 colours. The tree (a mega tree, a matrix, any model with a grid) gets evenly spread spots, placed by where its pixels really are in the layout, so on a 360° mega tree they go all the way round; it shows every bauble hung so far for a while after each new one, or all the time. A star on top, if you pick one, twinkles in its colour (visitors can change it) and shines at each new bauble. When it is full: a rainbow party, then it starts again. Pick the tree, then Save.
